notes.title: Update 3.38
notes.content:
New things added this update:



-New OST for perks page and boxing gym ambiance for training. 

-Sanctioned fights now allow a rank difference up to 4. 

-New fighters added – Pillow Fist Haney, Paulie Negitiviti, Ivan Drogo 

-More boxer face and body skins, 

-New main title screen for wide screens. 

-General UI enhancements.

notes.title: Update 3.37 Ring Blood
notes.content:
A small update that adds blood that spreads around the ring over the course of a fight.

I've been busy lately and unable to work on the game! But should have more time soon!



Now go smash someone's face in

notes.title: Update 3.31
notes.content:
Bugfix: apply accuracy and efficiency punch perks to 'Professional Skills"

Bugfix: apply punch talents to 'Professional Skills"

notes.title: Update 3.30
notes.content:
-Bugfix: Exiting a hot-seat sparring match before the first bell saved the fight as "in progress" in the campaign

-Bugfix: "Liver Shot" was not correctly getting modified by some perks

-Bugfix: "Liver Shot" was missing "Body Snatcher" energy drain tooltip

-Bugfix: Fight log printed wrong fighter's name when a punch into guard broke the guard

-Bugfix: Fight log printed wrong fighter's name when "Impenetrable Guard" triggered

-Bugfix: "Rope a Dope" worked against "Liver Shot"

-Bugfix: Show base hit chance for "Professional Skills"

-Bugfix: Legendary boxers had all perks available after resetting perks

-Prevent "Legendary" perk from getting wiped on perk reset

-Reword Lightweight perk description for clarity

-Critical knockdown injuries are now relevant to the punch thrown (these happen when a punch damages an opponent such that they would have less than -15 health)

-Add new boxer skins

-Add option to resurrect or leave legendary boxers dead when re-generating roster

-Add new perks: "Pain Rage", "Pain Clarity"

notes.title: Update 3.29
notes.content:
Small update to address cheesing the ai and perk balance.



- AI: Improve bot decision making in fights (specifically when cornered by a fighter with guard up and countering)

- Manny Pacmeow gains "southpaw" perk

- Legendary boxer's "legendary" perk no longer counts towards their perk total

- "Fast Fist" now ignores "Peek a Boo"

- "Glory in Death" reduces injury debuff by 30% when badly injured

- Add audio cues when rolling boxers (the higher pitched tone the better the fighter)

notes.title: Simulate fights between any two boxer!
notes.content:
Turn Based Boxing 
The playtest is ending and the game is now released! Thanks for all your support! I will continue to support the game however, and add and fix things as we go!




[previewyoutube="xtHcwR6LAgQ;full"][/previewyoutube]Simulate Fights
You can now simulate fights between any two fighter, even ones that are not in your gym.

If the two fighter's are too far apart in rank, it will be a sparring match, otherwise it may be a fully sanctioned fight that goes on their record.

You can import boxer strings right into simulated fights, and they will be added to your game after the fight.

2 player hot seat is now available for sparring matches


More Details on update 3.26
- Update AI to generally be smarter, AI now uses professional skills  

- Make boxers face each other when they switch sides  

- Bugfix: Simulate Fights red corner was not picking a strategy in the first round  

- Bugfix: Un-counterable straights were counterable by "peek-a-boo" and "anger"  

- Bugfix: Sometimes, AI would double side step, wasting an action  

- Bugfix: Patch boxer creator glitch that allowed male and female fighters to have the opposite gender's perk  

- Add "show more" btn to Simulate Fight Page  

- Add drop downs to select existing fighters in Simulate Fight  

- Add toggle for sparring fight when simulating fights (won’t count on record or risk death)  

- Rename injuries of organs that cannot be "broken" to "hemorrhaged"  

- KO punch now ends the fight instantly with no count  

- Show healing and energy recovery amounts when choosing a corner action  

- Slightly increase counter punch damage  

- Add a few new boxer faces  

- Add new Legendary boxers: Sugar Ray Leopard, George Forehead, Lennox Loose-screws, Oscar De La Yayo, Joy Bones Jr.

notes.title: Playtest now accepting players!
notes.content:
The steam playtest is now live!

If you want to join, please click the Join Playtest button on the steam page.

Submit feedback / bugs to the steam discussion, or on my discord server 

Here are some new things added for this playtest.
 
 Add basic shortcut keys to quickly access action categories in a fight. 
 Add "Dirty Mouth" perk (this is a rare and hidden perk that makes the boxer's swear and cuss) I might remove this..
AI improvements - make them smarter
Fix boxer generation perks selection bug: Reset roster recommended (Opponents were getting to many perks to early)
Fix bug where logs showed wrong boxer name when countering.
Perks balancing
Remove base plate (chair) from fighter inside the ring
Train quickly with 5x and 10x training buttons
Recover stamina when getting up from a knock down
Add "undertaker perk" (effects knock down recovery stamina gain)
Allow 0% injury chance (disable death)

notes.title: Added "Combos", New perks, Boxer Faces, and Legendary Fighters
notes.content:
Added now to the demo:

Legendary fighters are fightable and at the top of the rankings, as well as a few custom easter egg boxers scattered around the roster. (more soon)

Added more perks, 1 for each punch type that boosts accuracy.
Added 'Awkward" perk

Added "Combos".

Here is a list of combos:
